{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches doc/release-notes-34132.md only as release documentation accompanying the code changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation updates are incidental to the database and coin-view error-handling refactoring."
    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Alters error handling in src/index/txindex.cpp, src/index/base.cpp, and other index files, converting txindex consistency and block-file read failures into fatal errors.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents silent failure or single-RPC errors on corrupted txindex reads while the node continues running with damaged storage. Review discussion highlights the architectural tension of taking down operating nodes for non-essential optional index failures, making thorough index review essential."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/kernel/notifications_interface.h and bitcoinkernel.h to route fatal database errors through the kernel notification boundary.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.55,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Changes fatal error reporting and crash semantics across the kernel API boundary. Reviewers specifically noted this affects library host applications during startup and automated recovery paths."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/txmempool.cpp and src/txmempool.h (+1/-1) merely to adapt to CCoinsView method signature changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The edits in mempool files are purely mechanical adjustments to HaveCoin and view lookups."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/rpc/blockchain.cpp (+1/-0) solely as a call site affected by the underlying index read changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The change does not alter the RPC subsystem, interfaces, or server infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test modifications and additions test coinsdb read errors and database wrapper behavior rather than test framework utilities.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Changes in test files accompany and validate the validation and index error-handling changes rather than developing shared testing machinery."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to CDBWrapper belong to validation per the category definition, while init.cpp changes are minor deletions.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Database wrapper and LevelDB interactions fall under validation rather than generic utilities."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the 'UTXO Db and Indexes' label and refactors core chainstate storage, CDBWrapper error handling, and CCoinsView architecture.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Eliminates a data integrity hazard where CDBWrapper::Read() returned false on deserialization errors, masking database corruption as missing keys. It also simplifies the coin-view hierarchy by removing CCoinsViewErrorCatcher and marking coin lookups noexcept."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 2,
    "bug_severity": 2,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 0,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
